hypothesis: P5.3 V1 failed partly because the market-state variable itself was absorbing. Separating continuous MARKET_STATE from the human-gated RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK should preserve the immutable V1 raw signal evidence while making later market regimes observable.
scope: Architecture isolation only. No feature, atom, threshold, profile, event, behavior multiplier, economic selection, production, or trading authorization change.
frozen_from_v1_without_change: P5.1 event taxonomy and reporting buckets

MARKET_STATE.purpose: Continuous research classification of current market evidence.
MARKET_STATE.raw_candidate_source: Exactly the V1 raw_candidate implementation and V1 evidence atoms.
MARKET_STATE.pre_first_v1_flat_parity: Before the first V1 final-state FLAT, V2 MARKET_STATE must exactly equal V1 final state for every profile/date.
MARKET_STATE.hard_flat_entry: A fully proven raw FLAT still enters MARKET_STATE=FLAT immediately with no persistence.
MARKET_STATE.flat_recovery: After MARKET_STATE=FLAT, a less-severe raw candidate uses the unchanged profile deescalation_clear_days. After that many consecutive complete initialized dates below FLAT, MARKET_STATE moves exactly one severity step lower, resets counters, and every further lower step requires a fresh clear period.
MARKET_STATE.ordinary_escalation: Identical to V1 severity-index persistence mechanics.
MARKET_STATE.ordinary_deescalation: Identical to V1 one-step clear-period mechanics, now also applicable when current MARKET_STATE is FLAT.
MARKET_STATE.missing_data: Hold MARKET_STATE and reset ordinary counters. Missing data cannot de-risk or unlock anything. A hard FLAT escalation remains allowed only with the same complete proof as V1.

RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.purpose: Operational permission control, distinct from market classification.
RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.trigger: An actual operational transition to zero directional exposure / FLAT sets HUMAN_REAUTH_REQUIRED.
RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.unlock: Explicit human approval outside P5.3 only.
RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.historical_research_output: For audit, V2 may report a COUNTERFACTUAL_PERMISSION_LOCK that becomes HUMAN_REAUTH_REQUIRED on the first historical MARKET_STATE=FLAT and never auto-unlocks. This is diagnostic only and does not imply that historical market-state classification must remain FLAT.

required_v2_outputs: daily raw candidate and evidence atoms for all three unchanged profiles
daily V2 MARKET_STATE for all three profiles
100% raw-candidate parity report versus immutable V1 result wherever V1 raw candidate is defined
100% pre-first-FLAT final-state parity versus immutable V1
recovery date after each FLAT episode
interpretation_rule: Passing these gates means only that the architecture separation restores a non-degenerate market-state history while preserving V1 signals. It does not mean any profile is robust, economically superior, or production-ready. P5.4 may then preregister behavior mappings; P5.5 owns event-level robustness and economic selection.
forbidden: change any V1 profile persistence or clear period
edit immutable P5.2 or P5.3 V1 results
hide or relabel the 2021-02-23 false FLAT
select a profile from V2 architecture evidence alone
